_what: The worst night the chapter can hand forward. One bell already cracked by the fallen stair, then both patterns rung so badly that two more crack: BELLS_CRACKED reaches 3, which is what ch7 mutes lanes on and ch8 prints. The auto-ringer is switched on late in each round, so most of the pattern is simply missed.

steps.eval: (() => { const KEYS=['a','c','m','/']; if (window.__auto) clearInterval(window.__auto); window.__auto = setInterval(() => { document.querySelectorAll('#widget .lane').forEach((lane, i) => { const hy = lane.clientHeight - 58; lane.querySelectorAll('.orb:not(.mimic)').forEach(o => { if (o.__hit) return; const y = parseFloat(o.style.top) + 23; if (Math.abs(y - hy) < 22) { o.__hit = true; window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: KEYS[i], code: 'Key' + KEYS[i].toUpperCase(), bubbles: true })); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { key: KEYS[i], bubbles: true })); } }); }); }, 25); return 'auto-ringer on (late)'; })()

steps.expect: A bell is cracked. 2 of four.

steps._note: the picture has to agree with the sentence the room has just read. Game.setArt memoises on name+params and six scenes share ch6_lid, so before artParams a bell cracked in a round never reached the backdrop at all.
